title: KARC explicit basis with shared dynamical-system Views
hypothesis: A shared explicit KARC feature bank plus compact system-specific readout Views predicts heldout dynamical trajectories with lower complete bytes than independent closed-form KARC readouts and improves on native low-rank readout factorization.

world.basis: fixed Fourier features of delayed coordinates
world.teacher: system readouts are shared center plus rank-2 system-specific perturbations

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native readout-factor alias or byte/quality gate miss.

controls: independent closed-form KARC readout per system
shared KARC basis with one readout
native low-rank factorization of KARC readouts
success_gate: heldout rollout nRMSE <=0.02, at least 25% fewer complete bytes than independent KARC readouts, and strict frontier gain over native low-rank readout control.
failure_gate: FAIL if native readout factors match Mirror or quality/storage gate misses.

compute.stability: report finite horizon output; readout is nonlinear Fourier map

boundaries: Synthetic stable linear dynamics only; no KARC reproduction or real forecasting claim.
System readout codes are present for all scored systems; no unseen-system code inference claim.
No fresh runs after native alias or gate failure.
